verdict.rationale: Bolna's Agent Studio is documented as turning a short use-case description into a production-grade, call-ready voice agent in 5–8 minutes with no prompt engineering. That is the core of AI-assisted agent authoring from a description, but the support rests on a single first-party docs statement. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-driven improvement of existing prompts, AI-generated conversation flows, AI-generated test cases, deeper documentation of what Studio produces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
